text:
zoe: Dropping a new idea: can we add a 'Copy with context' option next to the correlation pill? It would copy a small JSON blob `{"trace_id":..., "span_id":..., "service":..., "timestamp":...}` so support can paste full context into tickets. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1779991234.png :bulb:
ali: Backend caveats: large traces -> sensitive fields. If we include `service` or a request path we might leak PII. Need a scrub list and an export permission check. Also prefer async for anything that requires fetching related spans.
marco: UX: make default Copy = trace_id only. Add a chevron menu on the pill with: "Copy ID", "Copy permalink", "Copy JSON (context)", "Export HAR (request)". HAR export is heavy; should be an async job that posts a download link. Keyboard shortcut idea: when pill focused, pressing Enter opens menu, pressing C copies default.
aria: Accessibility notes: aria-labels should be explicit: aria-label="Copy trace identifier" and for JSON option aria-label="Copy trace context as JSON". Use aria-live=polite for success messages like "Trace context copied to clipboard". If we show expanded JSON, present it in a <pre> with role=document and ensure keyboard focusable.
zoe: Good points. Proposal: default Copy = trace_id; add two-tier menu for advanced copies. Advanced copies require `export` scope/permission (flag in UI if the user lacks it). For HAR/JSON we show a small privacy scrub checkbox in the modal: "Remove headers and bodies that may contain PII" (checked by default).
ali: Agree on scrub checkbox. Server should validate allowed fields and redact before returning. Also add rate-limiting for HAR exports. Implementation snippet for client copy: `try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(blob)) } catch(e) { /* fallback to hidden textarea + execCommand('copy') */ }`
marco: Microcopy suggestions: use the phrase "correlation identifier" in tooltips, and for advanced export modal title use "Export request data" with subtitle "You may remove sensitive fields before downloading". For the menu items show file extensions: "Copy JSON (context)" and "Export HAR (.har)".
support-bot: FYI: data export rules: https://redwood.policy/data-exports — any export that includes request headers/bodies requires approval for enterprise orgs. Tagging @legal if needed.
ux-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1779991234 — demo includes keyboard flow and scrub modal. Feedback window 48h :calendar:
